title: RoutePlan
description: Deterministic shared-core Mode-1 route planning result.

selectedProviderId.description: Chosen primary provider ID, if any.

fallbackProviderIds.description: Fallback provider IDs ordered after the primary selection.

controls.description: What this candidate must do with each requested speech control (ADR 025), in request order, evaluated on the bound voice (or on the task's control states when the provider lists no voices). Every 'required' control has decision 'apply'. Absent when the request names no controls.

decision.title: ControlDecision
decision.description: 'apply': the provider must apply the value. 'omit': the provider must leave the control at its normal behaviour and report it as not applied with this reason.

voice.description: The voice this candidate must use if it is attempted, chosen by the planner from the provider's dynamic voice inventory. It is the best voice that satisfies the request's locale, required voice traits and privacy — under local-required privacy always one that keeps data on the device — ranked by preferred id, then preferred gender, then exact locale region, then on-device before network. The adapter must use the voice with this id, or one with exactly these traits when the voice has no id. Absent when the request names no locale or voice, or the provider does not list its voices; the adapter then chooses itself under the same rules.

rejectedProviders.description: Providers filtered out during planning together with machine-readable reasons.

code.description: Normalized rejection reason. 'streaming_not_supported' means the descriptor does not statically declare Mode-2 streaming; 'streaming_unavailable' means it declares streaming but the dynamic capability snapshot reports it cannot stream in the current host environment. 'not_in_model_profile' means the request named a model profile that does not list this provider. 'input_not_supported', 'output_delivery_not_supported', 'output_format_not_supported', 'locale_not_supported' and 'voice_not_available' mean the provider's task capability lacks an input kind, output delivery, media type, locale or voice the request requires. 'prepare_not_supported' means the task capability declares no prepare(). 'not_ready' means the provider, task or required voice exists but is not prepared yet, so prepare() can make it available. 'speech_control_unsupported' means no voice the provider could bind supports a required speech control for the requested delivery; 'speech_control_out_of_range' means one supports it, but not the requested value (ADR 025).

failureCode.description: Normalized routing failure class when no provider is selected.

explanation.description: Human-readable selection or failure explanation suitable for telemetry/debugging.

controlOmissionReason.title: ControlOmissionReason
controlOmissionReason.description: Why a preferred control is omitted: 'unsupported' (not declared for this delivery, or the bound voice disables it), 'out_of_range' (outside the known range), 'range_unknown' (available, but no range is known), 'availability_unknown' (no state says it works).
